analysis_integrity.function_name_verification: narrative names are unverified model labels; selectors and addresses are the verified identities

deterministic_rule_observation.vuln_type_hint: Improper Access Control Of Close-Source Contract

limitations: Function identities use observed calldata selectors. Human-readable names require verified ABI/source at the execution context; selector-database labels are not proof.

finding_provenance.note: Findings with analysis_role unknown_suspect are retained proposals whose vulnerable status is not established: they are neither confirmed vulnerable nor dismissed. citations, when present, name each analysis unit that cited the finding with its own structural relation in this run's trace only; a finding without citations has undetermined provenance - it was neither analyzed nor recorded as cited. also_analyzed marks a cited function that was additionally analyzed on its own. analyzed_target marks functions the analysis unit itself analyzed.

score_provenance.formula: total = 1 - product(1 - component) over the listed components

exploitability.meaning: Deterministic pre-analysis rule confidence, not an exploitability assessment. No function-level model evidence feeds the priority score.
